section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: INSPECTION OF FRONT DOOR KEY LOCK AND UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT.
ocr_text:
BE-90
BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System

C
INSPECTION OF FRONT DOOR KEY LOCK AND UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT.

Turn ignition switch off.

COMPUTER

Disconnect computer connector and inspect
connector on wire harness side as follows.

LH FRONT
DOOR

INSPECT KEY LOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT
Is there continuity between terminal 11 and
ground with LH front door locked with key?

No
Open circuit in LH front door key lock
switch circuit.

Yes

Is there continuity between terminal 11 and
ground with LH front door unlocked with
key?

Yes
Short circuit in LH front door key lock
switch circuit.

No

INSPECT KEY UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT
Is there continuity between terminal 3 and
ground with LH front door unlocked with
key?

No
Open circuit in LH front door key unlock
switch circuit.

Yes

Is there continuity between terminal 3 and
ground with LH front door locked with key?

Yes
Short circuit in LH front door key unlock
switch circuit.

RH FRONT
DOOR

No

INSPECT KEY LOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT
Is there continuity between terminal 11 and
ground with RH front door locked with key?

No
Open circuit in RH front door key lock
switch circuit.

Yes

Is there continuity between terminal 11 and
ground with RH front door unlocked with
key?

Yes
Short circuit in RH front door key lock
switch circuit.

No

INSPECT KEY UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT
Is there continuity between terminal 3 and
ground with RH front door unlocked with
key?

No
Open circuit in RH front door key unlock
switch circuit.

Yes

Is there continuity between terminal 3 and
ground with RH front door locked with key?

Yes
Short circuit in RH front door key unlock
switch circuit.

No

Replace computer. Then recheck system.
